contentHtml:
Anyone may start a company in the UAE, even if they are not from the nation. However, they must get a business license to operate their company lawfully in this country. As their firm grows and expands, they may need to modify additional business activities to their UAE trade license.

This blog post will help clarify the criteria for adding more activities to your company’s trade licenses. If another body governs your company activities in the UAE, you must get prior authorization before adding the latest activity to your trade license. This is especially important if you’re unfamiliar with how to add activities to a trade license or unsure about the categories listed under UAE trade license activities details.

Understanding Trade License Activities in UAE

A license identifies the business activities by indicating its goods or services and target market. For instance, your company may be licensed for operations such as wholesale business, selling goods at retail, or providing particular services.

The UAE authorities force enterprises to choose their activity from a predetermined list. This collection is divided into significant categories called commercial activity groupings. These groups help entrepreneurs find and pick activities that correspond with their company’s aims, easing the business creation process.

The UAE divides business operations into four primary categories: manufacturing, commercial, professional, and tourist. Each significant category is further separated into segments, enabling you to choose tasks directly related to your business.

A single trade license may cover several activities, depending on the licensing authority’s requirements and license category. While being explicit in activity choices might reassure investors such as banks, it is feasible to incorporate activities from multiple subgroups on a single license based on the license category and the authority’s unique criteria. You must conduct research and adhere to all applicable regulations to ensure your company runs smoothly and legally.

To make an informed choice, businesses can refer to the official list of trade license activities in Dubai, which outlines all the approved sectors and services for different business types.

Adding New Business Activities to a UAE Trade License: Process

Growing your firm in the UAE involves adding more commercial activities to your business license. The procedure entails requesting clearance from DED and submitting the required documentation. Here are the step-by-step instructions for modifying your trade license and lawfully incorporating new trade license activities into your firm.

Acquire Primary Approval:

For the initial step of the process, you must request the DED for initial permission to alter your trade license. This certification verifies that your intended business operations comply with UAE legislation and enables you to continue with the required changes.

Request For Trade License Modifications:

Once initial permission is given, you must complete and submit the commercial license modification application. Verify that all necessary credentials from company directors or investors are included, if relevant.

Acquire a No Objection Certificate:

A No Objection Certificate is significant legal proof that verifies there are no barriers to adding extra activities to your trade license. This certification may be requested by all parties involved, partners, or appropriate authorities. 

Fulfill the Legal Formalities:

Limited Liability Companies (LLCs) must satisfy extra legal obligations:
A professional translator is required to translate any modifications to the LLC agreement.
The Notary Public must certify this addition at the DED.
If appropriate, a Court Settlement contract must be signed by the Notary.

Provide the necessary documents:

To complete the modification, send the following papers to the DED:
Original trade license and incorporation certificate.
Filled out the company’s license application for modification.
A copy of the leasing contract for the workspace.
Preliminary permission letter from the UAE’s Registrar Authority.
Approval from the DED and No Objection Certificate.
Attested amendments to the LLC and Court Agreements.
A copy of the official list of activities for trade license in Dubai, especially if you’re branching into new sectors.

Acquire an Amended Trade License:

Once the DED has reviewed and approved all documentation, you will be notified to continue with the payment. After payment, you will obtain a modified trade license that reflects the newly added company operations.

Key Considerations for Amending Trade License Activities in the UAE

Changing a trade license in the UAE is vital for companies wishing to reorganize their trade license activities or grow. One must grasp the following fundamental points before making any changes.

Trade License Modification Procedure:

Companies can request a trade license modification to add events or make other changes. One might also finish this procedure at the time of license renewal.

If you’re not sure how to add activities in trade license or whether your proposed services align with current approvals, consulting the trade license activities list is a smart first step.

Alterations Might Incorporate:

Adjusting the commercial name
Changing the authorized capital
Changing the company address
Adding or deleting associates
Adjusting sponsors or regional agents for Mainland Companies
Changing corporate management records.

Compatibility To Include Other Activities:

If they fit the current business structure and license category, may other trade license activities be added? If the latest activity deviates, another company license might be needed.

Rules & Compliance Policies:

Every UAE business zone and licensing body has different policies for trade license changes. Before requesting any adjustments, make sure the necessary authorities have checked the most current rules.

Third-Party Reviews:

Certain company operations consider permits from outside agencies, such as trade associations, municipalities, or government authorities. These permissions must be obtained and presented with the trade license modification application.

Costs of Trade License Activities Modification

The UAE trade license modification fee might be around two thousand AED in the free zone and on the mainland. Your trade license type, the commercial activity you include in a trade license, and your company location affect the price tag when adding more operations to a trade license.

Our Al Buraq advisors can assist you with the precise pricing and expenses. The cost may also vary based on the nature of the Dubai E-Trader License. If you renew the trade license at the same time, it can also affect the cost.

Advantages of Adding New Business Activities to UAE Trade License

As your company grows, you might add operations to your trade license in Dubai. The benefits of this include:


Limitless Opportunities:

Over time, your company may expand. Your horizons will open, and additional revenue streams will be yours.

A Few Steps Ahead of Opponents:

Present a range of goods and services to expand your company portfolio. It will enable you to acquire a commanding market share and draw more consumers.

Remain Flexible And Encourage Advancement:

Engaging in emerging trade license activities in your company keeps you adaptable and open to changes in the market’s direction. Businesses that regularly review their trade license activities Dubai can pivot more effectively and stay ahead of market trends.

Guard Against Legal Challenges:

Recall that you must add activities to the trade license to operate lawfully in the country. Making sure all actions are allowed will help you stay free from any legal issues.

Conclusion

To sum up, increasing your company’s operations in the UAE involves rigorous preparation and regulatory observance. Including fresh operations within your trade license guarantees compliance and lets your company expand and diversify in an extremely competitive sector. Regulatory authorities will easily modify your trade license if you follow the correct processes, get the required permissions, and guarantee compatibility with your company structure.

Don’t forget to conduct a trade license verification to ensure all added activities are officially updated and recognized by the relevant UAE authorities. Maintaining knowledge of laws particular to your jurisdiction and consulting experts when necessary can help simplify the amendment process and encourage your company’s growth in the United Arab Emirates.

FAQs

What is the expense to update or add activities to a Dubai trade license?

Costs differ depending on jurisdiction and business activities. Expect to pay the government costs for the amending process, notarization, and each extra activity group.

How do I add further business activity to my Dubai trade license?

You need to apply to the DET, gain initial approval, send in a modification request, revise your MOA, and pay the charges.

Do I require special permission to add more activities to my trade license?

Yes, regulated industries like medical care, banking, and food need to get NOCs from the right outside government agencies before the DET gives its final clearance.

Can I add more than one activity under a single UAE trade license?

Under a single trade license, mainland Dubai normally lets you add up to ten related activities as long as they are suitable and fit under the same trade license category.

What papers do you need to change a trade license in the UAE?

The original trade license, a filled-out modification form, initial permission from DET, and a notarized modification to the MOA are all normally needed.
